Employer pages: Ashby API (Sticker Mule), Greenhouse API (Canonical), We Work Remotely posting pages (Alloy, Airbnb), Jobicy posting pages (Sticker Mule, Supabase, EDB, Udacity), RemoteOK (Kodland), Himalayas API (Xperteez, KOMBO), LinkedIn guest job pages (ADG, Allied Global, Seedtag, Alliance of Bioversity and CIAT)

method.filtering_summary: Live search at 7:34 AM EAT on 11 sources (all answered) pulled 2,268 postings: 1,783 were older than 7 days, 165 senior or excluded titles, 214 not target roles, 46 excluded Kenya and 18 duplicates. Of the 42 that passed, 18 had already been shown in earlier briefings or reviewed. Of the 24 new ones, 2 made the shortlist after a check on the posting itself, and both are long-running listings that were relisted this week. The rest were dropped: 5+ or 7+ year asks (Alloy, Supabase, EDB, Udacity, three ADG roles, Allied Global), US-only or EU-country-only remote rules (Airbnb, Seedtag), a German-language lead role, an unconfirmable AI-training contract, a kids' coding-tutor job, a mid-senior consultancy, and non-software or non-job listings (mechatronics internships, a robotics role, a tender). ADG's Software Engineer and Test Engineer roles are in today's Kenya section instead. A web search for junior remote roles found only listings older than 7 days. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: DeepSeek ships a faster V4.1-Flash and opens its search API
stories.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 resolved 77% of DeepSWE v1.1 tasks in DeepSeek's own tests (up from 74.2%), keeps the same API prices, and ships MIT-licensed weights; new Search and Fetch APIs cost 75 cents per 1,000 successful requests.
stories.why: A cheap, open coding model plus a ready-made web search API for agents he builds.

stories.title: Replit makes OpenAI the default model for Replit Agent
stories.summary: CEO Amjad Masad said ChatGPT is now Replit Agent's default over Anthropic on cost and performance, though Claude models stay selectable; enterprise contracts are now about 15% of Replit's revenue.
stories.why: Shows how fast AI coding platforms switch model providers, which matters when he picks models for client work.

stories.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund
stories.summary: Subject to shareholder approval, the fund starts with 5% of shares, may grow 2 points for every 50% rise in value, and could fund work on AI job disruption; Anthropic told investors Q3 revenue was $16.8 billion ahead of a planned IPO.
stories.why: The biggest AI IPO story of the week, and it ties AI gains to the job market he's entering.

stories.title: Evos raises $9 million for AI agents that run industrial back offices
stories.summary: Evos, which builds AI agents that automate work for industrial businesses such as freight brokerages, raised a $9 million pre-seed co-led by Uncork Capital and Field Ventures.
stories.why: An early-stage agent-automation startup of the kind that hires engineers who build workflow automations.

stories.title: Anthropic's junior technical hiring falls from 27% to 9% of hires
stories.summary: Anthropic's own report says junior employees in technical teams fell from 21% to 14% since early 2025, and hiring managers now weigh autonomy, judgment and creative AI-tool use more than domain expertise.
stories.why: Junior roles at AI-heavy firms now reward showing judgment and real AI-tool use, which is worth leading with in his applications.

stories.title: OpenAI adds 200 Dublin jobs, including forward deployed engineers
stories.summary: OpenAI will add 200 more jobs at its Dublin EU headquarters, three months after announcing 250, with some going to a new Applied AI Lab for forward deployed, solutions and privacy engineers.
stories.why: Forward deployed and solutions engineering keep growing as a hiring track that fits his profile.

stories.title: Disney will hire most of bankrupt Character.AI's staff
stories.summary: A court filing shows Disney agreed to make offers to at least 60 Character.AI employees, an estimated $60 million in yearly pay, after the chatbot startup filed for bankruptcy.
stories.why: Big companies are absorbing whole AI teams, a sign that applied-AI experience stays in demand even when startups fail.

stories.title: Two Kenyan AI startups win Meta pitchathon funding
stories.summary: Neural Labs Africa and Me-Nasoma each won $5,000 (about Sh650,000) in equity-free funding at the first AI Academy Kenya Pitchathon run by Meta and This Is Digital, which drew more than 426 applications.
stories.why: Nairobi's AI startup scene is busy, and finalists such as JuaFlow and Sawazisha AI build the kind of automation he does.

stories.title: Amref opens a Nairobi health innovation hub aiming for 10,000 youth jobs
stories.summary: The Amref Health Innovation Hub launched in Nairobi on Oct 18 with a goal of 10,000 jobs for African youth and frontline health workers over five years; Safaricom Foundation chair Joseph Ogutu pointed to M-PESA's growth as the model.
stories.why: A new Nairobi hub for health-tech builders, a possible place to find local projects or roles.
